Nîmes.question: This limestone monolith of over _____ metres (6.6 ft) in height dates to approximately 2500 BCE, and is considered the oldest monument in Nîmes
Nîmes.fact: This limestone monolith of over 2 metres (6.6 ft) in height dates to approximately 2500 BCE, and is considered the oldest monument in Nîmes. During the 3rd and 2nd centuries BCE, a surrounding wall was built with a dry-stone tower at the summit, which was later incorporated into the Tour Magne.
